kjv: The preparations of the heart in man, and the answer of the tongue, [is] from the LORD
mine: The plans of the heart belong to man, but the answer of the tongue is from Yahweh
note: Hebrew le'adam ... umeYHWH contrasts "to man belong" with "from Yahweh"; the KJV merges both halves so that both come from God, losing the antithesis.

kjv: The LORD hath made all [things] for himself
mine: Yahweh has made everything for its purpose
note: Hebrew lamma'anehu is "for its answer/purpose" (ma'aneh) rather than "for his own sake"; a verse often cited in predestination debates.
